subject.title: Surface Codex final answer candidates in activity

question: Should this PR land as the bounded answer-candidate Activity slice for native Codex, or should the work be folded into the broader progress UX tracked by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/80039?
rationale: The patch is coherent and proven, but it creates a permanent Control UI Activity concept for final-answer candidates while the broader Codex progress/privacy UX remains an open maintainer decision.

options.title: Land Bounded Slice
options.body: Rebase onto the current Control UI modules, preserve existing item/preamble behavior, and land answer-candidate Activity as a narrow part of the broader progress work.

options.title: Fold Into Broader UX
options.body: Keep the PR open or ask for a replacement that handles answer candidates together with the full native Codex plan/item/progress surface.

options.title: Decline Activity Entries
options.body: Close or redirect the PR if maintainers decide final-answer candidate lifecycle should not be a user-visible Activity concept.

recommendation.title: Land Bounded Slice
recommendation.body: Rebase onto the current Control UI modules, preserve existing item/preamble behavior, and land answer-candidate Activity as a narrow part of the broader progress work.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns recent Codex/operator-observability work and is the strongest history signal for deciding how this Activity slice fits the broader Codex progress surface.
